question: What is the longitudinal tensile strength Xt of IM7/8552?
answer: The longitudinal tensile strength Xt of IM7/8552 is 2212 MPa (source: NCAMP NCP-RP-2009-028 Rev B, Table 3-3 p.37, RTD mean as-measured; status: verified_pdf). This value was retrieved from the database using a Python script.  The database confirms this value as verified.

question: Độ bền cắt S của AS4/8552 là bao nhiêu?
answer: Độ bền cắt S của AS4/8552 là 91.6 MPa (source [F]: NCAMP NCP-RP-2010-008 Rev D, lamina summary table p.37, RTD mean as-measured; verification status: verified_pdf). This value was obtained from a database lookup.

question: What is E1 of T1100G/3960 and which report is it from?
answer: The longitudinal modulus (E1) of the T1100G/3960 material is 170.5 GPa (source: [1]: lamina summary table p.34, RTD mean as-measured). This value was obtained from the NCAMP NCP-RP-2023-002 Rev B report.

question: Give the transverse compressive strength Yc of T650/5320-1.
answer: Yc (transverse compressive strength) of T650/5320-1 = 274 MPa (source: NCAMP NCP-RP-2013-001 Rev A, Table 3-3 p.35, RTD mean as-measured; status: verified_pdf). Note: Checked visually on PDF page 35. S conflict resolved: 15.639 ksi was SBS, correct F12s(5%) = 13.501 ksi

question: What is the Poisson's ratio nu12 of T40-800/5215? Is the value reliable?
answer: The Poisson’s ratio nu12 of T40-800/5215 is 0.164 (source: NCAMP NCP-RP (Cycom 5215 T40-800 Unitape), lamina summary table p.36, RTD mean as-measured; status: verified_pdf). The value is doubtful because it is anomalously low compared to the value for the transverse Poisson’s ratio (nu12c = 0.366 in same table).

question: Which NCAMP material has the highest Xt?
answer: Ranking computed by Python from the whole database (NCAMP materials only, 15 materials with data), property Xt (longitudinal tensile strength), highest first: 1. T1100G/3960: 3645 MPa (source: NCAMP NCP-RP-2023-002 Rev B, lamina summary table p.34, RTD mean as-measured; status: verified_pdf); 2. T1100GC/TC380: 3277 MPa (source: NCAMP NCP-RP-2025-010 Rev -, lamina summary table p.38, RTD mean as-measured; status: verified_pdf); 3. IM7G/EP2202: 2967 MPa (source: NCAMP NCP-RP-2014-006 N/C, lamina summary table p.35, RTD mean as-measured; status: verified_pdf).

question: Vật liệu sợi thủy tinh nào có mô đun dọc E1 lớn nhất?
answer: Vật liệu sợi thủy tinh có mô đun dọc E1 lớn nhất là E-glass/LY556 với giá trị 53.48 GPa (source: Soden, Hinton & Kaddour (1998) Compos Sci Technol 58:1011-1022 (WWFE-I); status: needs_check). The E-glass/MY750 material has a longitudinal modulus of 45.6 GPa (source: Soden, Hinton & Kaddour (1998) Compos Sci Technol 58:1011-1022 (WWFE-I); status: needs_check), and the S2-glass/BT250E-6 material has a longitudinal modulus of 44.7 GPa (source: NCAMP NCP-RP-2015-021 N/C, lamina summary table p.31, RTD mean as-measured; status: verified_pdf).

question: What is the tensile strength of titanium Ti-6Al-4V?
answer: The database does not contain it.

question: What is the in-plane shear strength S of T650/5250-5?
answer: The in-plane shear strength S of T650/5250-5 is not reported in the database (source: NCAMP NCP-RP (Cycom 5250-5 T650 Unitape), lamina summary table p.36, RTD mean as-measured; status: verified_pdf).

question: What is the fibre volume fraction of AS4/MTM45-1?
answer: The fibre volume fraction of AS4/MTM45-1 is 0.58 (source: NCAMP NCP-RP-2008-004 Rev B, Table 3-3 p.35, RTD (75F) mean as-measured; status: verified_pdf). This value was looked up by Python from the database.

question: What is Yc of Kevlar 49/epoxy?
answer: The transverse compressive strength (Yc) of Kevlar 49/epoxy is 53 MPa (source: Tsai & Hahn (1980) Introduction to Composite Materials, Technomic; status: conflict). This value is doubtful due to a discrepancy with other sources. The database value was looked up by Python.

question: Mô đun cắt G12 của IM7/BT250E-6 là bao nhiêu?
answer: Mô đun cắt G12 của IM7/BT250E-6 là 4.34 GPa (source [F]: NCAMP NCP-RP-2015-019 N/C, lamina summary table p.31, RTD mean as-measured).
